title: SPI-Math Curriculum Objective
description: A single learning objective in the SPI-Math curriculum graph. Objectives have stable identifiers independent of filenames, and form a directed graph via prerequisites and related-objective links. The objective is the anchor for traceability: every question item references one or more objective IDs.

objectiveId.description: Stable dotted identifier, readable and extensible, independent of filenames. Convention: SPI.<COURSE_OR_LEVEL>.<DOMAIN>.<TOPIC>[.<SUBTOPIC>][.<MICROSKILL>].<NN>. Example: SPI.IBDPAASL.SEQSER.ARITH.NTH_TERM.01

course.description: Course label (e.g. 'IB Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches SL', 'Grade 4').

level.description: Finer-grained level/grade within the stage if applicable (e.g. 'Year 1', 'Grade 4').

objectiveWording.description: The objective stated as a learner can-do statement, in international English.

prerequisites.description: Objective IDs that should be mastered first. Forms the prerequisite edges of the curriculum graph.

requiredRepresentations.description: Representations a question MUST use, if any.

vocabulary.description: Required terminology, in agreed international English.

notation.description: Required notation conventions (e.g. 'u_n for nth term', 'S_n for sum to n terms').

answerTypes.description: Answer types this objective can be assessed with. Must be a subset of the platform answer-type vocabulary (see question-item.schema.json answer.type).

calculatorPolicy.description: Default calculator expectation for this objective.

difficultyRange.description: Overall difficulty band range this objective is normally assessed within (1 = easiest .. 5 = hardest on the platform scale).

commonMisconceptions.description: Misconception IDs frequently associated with this objective.

crossDomainRelationships.description: Objective IDs in other domains this connects to (synoptic links).

sourceReferences.description: Evidence for this objective. Each entry cites a source and a locator.

externalAlignments.description: Alignment to external frameworks (e.g. an IB syllabus topic code). Reference only; never implies reuse rights.

reviewStatus.description: Curriculum-authority review state for the objective definition.

version.description: Semantic version of this objective definition.

examples.course: IB Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches SL
examples.microSkill: evaluate the nth term given first term and common difference
examples.objectiveWording: Find the nth term of an arithmetic sequence given the first term and common difference.
successCriteria: Correctly identifies the first term and common difference.
Applies u_n = u_1 + (n - 1)d with correct use of (n - 1).

sourceReferences.locator: Oxford ToC 1.2 Arithmetic and geometric sequences
